title: Shortest Superstring
description: Find the shortest string that contains every word in the input as a substring.
pseudocode:
1. Precompute overlap between every pair of strings
2. Initialize DP table with bitmask to store path
3. Iterate through masks and last index to find min length
4. Reconstruct path from DP table result

steps.note: Initialize overlap matrix: alex-loves:0, alex-leetcode:0, loves-alex:0, loves-leetcode:0, leetcode-alex:0, leetcode-loves:0
Starting with single words in mask (binary 001, 010, 100)
